description: Uploads a new Cognigy.AI Extension from a URL. The extension package must be a .tar.gz file. This is an async operation that polls until complete. MUTATING: Set dryRun=false to upload.

dryRun.description: If true (default), validates without uploading. Set to false to actually upload.

projectId.description: The project ID to upload the extension to

name: upload_extension
